periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is tilted at an oblique angle, oriented downwards and inwards toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovoid shape where height exceeds horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the inferior boundary extends significantly below the horizontal midline of the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick band spanning the width of the shoulders and upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between ears positioned at the far lateral margins of the upper cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded and convex top boundary.
